reviews.comment: Dr. Powers is an amazing professor! She is always a email away if you have a question, and her TA's are nice!

truly cannot say enough good things about dr. powers. she makes such a difficult class seem very easy and manageable. she lets you do test corrects, happy to reexplain things, willing to change dates and workloads if the class agrees. worse exam grade gets dropped. just put in a LITTLE effort and its a guaranteed A.

Super accessible outside of class and very understanding. If you attend 90% of lectures, you are exempt from the final. Very little work except for group project at the end of the semester. Lectures can be a little boring, but you learn a lot of useful information for outside of the course!

Great professor! Despite being a 300-level course, she teaches the class in a way that even someone who did not take CHEM 120 can understand the course material pretty well. She even has corrections for her exams, where you can earn back 25% of the points you lost.

Dr. Powers is really great!! ARSC 105 with her was really fun and such an engaging class. She brought in guest lecturers for every unit, which was really cool. there are weekly assignments, but 2 are dropped at the end of the semester. There's also a group project debate at the end of the term.

Dr Powers is one of the best professors I have ever taken. Her lectures are clear and organized. She is always available at office hours, over email, and her team of PLTL is really helpful. Her class is by no means easy, but she makes it enjoyable. I learnt a lot from her. She is truly my role model.

If you get the opportunity to take this class you absolutely should. This class is an easy A and it fulfills the science credit. Mrs powers is very sweet and she really cares about this class and teaching everyone. Their are no exams and the final exam is exempted if you show up for 38/42 classes.

Super easy class. Weekly perussal hw which was annoying to navigate but not bad. Semester group project was an easy A just follow guidelines. She will tell you if your work is good for the project if you ask. If you attend 35/38 classes you are exempt from final. 10/10 class

This is definitely the best class to take for an easy science credit. Dr. Powers is a great professor who cares about her students. Attendance is basically the whole class, so as long as you actually show up an A is basically guaranteed. The class is based on a semester long group project that is very easy.

In ARSC 104, Professor Powers has many specialists come and teach about their different topics. Your only grades are once a week homework, attendance, where you have 3 free skips, and a group project. The lectures are all on interesting topics, and if you come to class, you won't have to take a final. Very easy, good class for a science credit.

Genuinely one of the best professors I have ever had. SUPER EASY. You get out of the final if you go to class and have less than 3 absences. Super easy to talk to, understanding, and the group project is so easy as well. The online homework maybe takes 20 minutes per week, and she splits up the group project into assignments. Take her if you can!
pop quizzes
Helpful prof. Weekly assignments and no exams. Attendance isn't mandatory but there are 6 pop quizzes over the sem so you should go to not miss them. Group projects. Easy A.

if you struggle with science, this class is your best bet. there are no tests, only open note pop quizzes and a big case study group project at the end of the semester. she brings in a lot of guest lecturers (some are kinda boring, some are fun), but she herself is a great lecturer. super nice, and shes always there to help and proofread your work!

Professor Powers was a great professor the class was very interesting. The class was not very difficult a couple pop quizzes that are very simple if you attend lectures. Lots of group work so be ready for that but nothing too time consuming Overall great class.

Dr. Powers is an excellent, kind professor! She focuses on you understanding the material rather than testing hard specifics. 'A' cutoff was 85 and she rewarded half-credit back for exam corrections. HWs are challenging but office hours help a lot. Exams are easier than HW and very similar to practice tests. Highly recommend her!

Dr. Powers is an excellent, caring professor! Her student-oriented mindset means she cares that you grasp basic ideas instead of hard specifics. The 7 problem sets are challenging but you can easily succeed by asking questions at TA/prof office hours. The exams are easier than the problem sets + very similar to the practice exams. Highly recommend!

One of my absolute FAVORITE professors at A&M!! She was always so kind and helpful, and you could correct exams for half credit back. The TA sessions were incredibly helpful for the homework, and she posted previous exams that were basically the same format as the actual exams and VERY helpful to study with! TAKE THIS CLASS!!

Class is focused more on you understanding the material rather than getting graded for it. Exams are graded very leniently, and the content of the practices is very similar to the content on the actual exams. Dr. Powers is a very approachable and kind person, and her lectures were always interesting. Attend office hours for problem sets.

Easiest class ever. Weekly packback and perusalls, pop quizzes but she drops 2 and you get most of the credit for turning it in. Group project is not bad, we got a 100 on all parts of it and it was not necessarily perfect. I wish I had room in my degree plan for part 2

Easiest class I have ever taken at A&M. Very chill prof. There are no exams but instead a group project (that is very easy.) There are 6 open-note pop quizzes that are usually given at the end of a guest lecture. (You get a 50% for putting your name on them) She drops the 2 lowest quizzes and assignments. My final grade for the class is a 100%

I love Dr. Powers! If you are looking for an easy life sciences class, definitely take this one. Attendance is not taken and there are about 6 pop quizzes throughout the semester but they are open note. No exams and one group projects. Different teachers every few weeks so it keeps it interesting!

Had her for both CHEM 362 and CHEM 433 at the same time, and it wasn't hard. For 362: her exams are very similar to the practice exams, so make sure to do them. The homework is tough, but go to office hours and she'll work through them with you. For 433: Do your best on prelab questions and procedure, but it's ok if wrong. Start reports early.

i took her for two semesters and she was amazing! the topics discussed in class are interesting and fun. we had one persuall and packback every week which was easy to do. the only thing is to be cautious about missing class as there are pop quizzes which can affect your grade a lot if you miss it. there is also a group project which is easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Powers is a very kind and caring professor. She made a great effort to ensure to we were engaged and actually learning the material. Even though her homework can be difficult, her exams are easier if you do the practice she gives you. She gives ample review and practice for her exams.

Class was SUPER easy. Gives pop quizzes but they are open note and super easy to follow. No exams, just one final project at the end of the semester. Project was simple enough (most difficult part was getting everyone to participate lol). I recommend if you need an easy credit!

LONG homeworks, each can take 2 weeks to complete. Lectures and any class material are only available in class, if you miss a day there's no good way to get that information. Not a hard grader, B starts at 75% and you can correct exams for half credit back. She's very enthusiastic but not super organized. Overall fun and a little messy
I love queen tamara. She's so passionate about everything she teaches and you can tell she really does care about students. If you've ever seen Austin and Ally she has big Ally vibes.

LOVE HER! so informative, and yes there are a lot of assignments, but submit on time and follow the rubric and you will get an A. Honestly I submitted a lot of the perusalls late and they count alot towards your grade but I still got an A. 2 group projects, 2 exams, 1 debate, weekly perusalls, weekly packbacks, ALOT of extra credit, & participation

The class is so easy. There is one pack back and a pursual a week takes like max hour a week if you're a try hard. She is super nice and the lectures are interesting. Brings in different experts to teach, 2 take home and open note exams, one group project that can be annoying but not that bad, class debate PowerPoint at end of semester (easy)

For SCEN 102. There's an insane amount of homework and much of your grade comes from group work. Despite this being a 100 level class, the Professor treats the projects like actual research and grades harshly. She's vague on instructions and finds reasons to take points off. The hw isn't bad but tedious. She's nice, but the class isn't worth it

Professor Powers is a really good professor. She is funny and her lectures are very easy to follow. You don't have to go to class because the class is really easy. The class feels like a high school science class. All the slides are on Canvas. During special topics, she brings guest speakers. The tests are open notes in an essay format.

Everything is open note and the lectures are posted online to use as well. Each lecture has its own homework to make sure you understand the concepts. Only 2 tests - midterm and final, but they are both open note and super easy!
She was very sweet! The class was very easy!

Brilliant woman and passionate about teaching chemistry.The best lab I have ever taken.  ripped me to shreds in the lab reports but my writing was transformed by the end. Labs are challenging and very interesting. She puts in a lot of effort and expects the same. This is one of the few classes that is, as a scientist, worth the time you'll put in
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Caring

reviews.comment: She is such a sweet person and helped me get more comfortable at A&M. She is very caring and will go out of her way to find resources to help you.
Professor Powers is probably one of the best professors I have had at my time at Texas A&M. She clearly explains the class content and always goes out of her way to help you. I hope the best for her.

Dr. Powers is an amazing professor. She made my transition to A&M much easier, and gave us helpful tips for how to succeed. She genuinely wants you to pass. There's really not a lot of work but you do have to show up to class. The class is also pass/fail

She's the best lab instructor I've had. She gives good details on lab techniques and characterization data required for lab reports. She's a chill person to talk to even if it isn't about chemistry. All the requirements for every assignment are given. Just DO NOT procrastinate on the lab reports.

Not only is Dr. Powers amazing at her job, but she's the single most caring professor I've ever met. She is always willing to go the extra mile to help students figure stuff out. And she is so enthusiastic about everything! She loves interacting with students, and she's always available to answer questions. Her lab is the best!
